# Runtime settings

These are Factorio runtime settings. Every entry is an administrator-controlled runtime-global map setting; there are no per-player options. Dedicated deployments may reconcile runtime-global settings through private RCON.

## Enable team evolution

`sceatorio-evolution-enabled` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

When disabled, each team's current enemy evolution is frozen. Kill counters and surface nest-consumption diagnostics advance without being back-charged after re-enabling.

Default: `true`.

## Evolution per connected minute

`sceatorio-evolution-time-per-minute` · `runtime-global` · `double`

Raw evolution added once per minute while at least one member of a team is connected on that surface. Multiple teammates do not multiply time.

Default: `0.00005`.

Range: `0` to `1`.

## Evolution per worm kill

`sceatorio-evolution-worm-per-kill` · `runtime-global` · `double`

Raw evolution added when a team kills a worm belonging to its own enemy force on that surface.

Default: `0.001`.

Range: `0` to `1`.

## Evolution per spawner kill

`sceatorio-evolution-spawner-per-kill` · `runtime-global` · `double`

Raw evolution added when a team kills a spawner belonging to its own enemy force on that surface.

Default: `0.007`.

Range: `0` to `1`.

## Evolution per nest-consumed pollution unit

`sceatorio-evolution-pollution-per-unit` · `runtime-global` · `double`

Raw evolution added for each new pollution unit recorded in that surface's cumulative output statistics for unit-spawner prototypes. Factorio exposes these counters per surface, not per force, so every team recorded there receives the same consumed delta. Gross emissions and non-spawner outputs do not count; trees and scrubbers can reduce future evolution by intercepting pollution before it reaches a nest.

Default: `0.0000009`.

Range: `0` to `1`.

## Vanilla evolution policy

`sceatorio-vanilla-evolution-policy` · `runtime-global` · `string`

The engine's shared evolution accumulator always stays disabled so it cannot double-count team ledgers. Disable also zeros its component coefficients; Preserve retains their configured numeric values for compatibility while leaving the accumulator off.

Default: `disable`.

Allowed values: `disable` (Disable for team forces), `preserve` (Preserve coefficients (engine off)).

## Isolate team electricity

`sceatorio-electricity-isolation` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

Disconnects direct copper links between different teams, rejects/refunds player or robot builds that would implicitly use another team's electric network, and rejects conflicting script-raised builds or clones. Neutral, enemy, system forces, and space platforms are not modified.

Default: `true`.

## Electricity sharing policy

`sceatorio-electricity-sharing-policy` · `runtime-global` · `string`

Mutual permits a pair only after both team owners opt in with /sceatorio-power-share. Isolated denies all cross-team sharing even when both teams opted in. Revocation removes direct links and blocks new implicit overlaps; relocate any implicit overlap that was accepted earlier.

Default: `mutual`.

Allowed values: `mutual` (Require both teams to opt in), `isolated` (Never share between teams).

## Protect offline team bases

`sceatorio-offline-defense-enabled` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

Immediately makes registered team-owned buildings, belts, rails, poles, turrets, roboports, vehicles, trains, land mines, and Space Age platform structures unbreakable when the last team member disconnects. The first returning member restores each entity's exact prior destructible state. Disable this setting before removing the mod so protected entities can be restored.

Default: `true`.

## Create team spawns on planets

`sceatorio-planet-spawns-enabled` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

Records one stable spawn for each team on each real planet after the first physical arrival. Space platforms and remote-view surfaces are excluded. On Vulcanus, the Oarc workaround destroys a tracked demolisher only when it enters the six-chunk warning radius around the nearest team spawn, granting that territory without rewriting terrain.

Default: `true`.

## Planet spawn safety radius

`sceatorio-planet-spawn-safety-radius` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Search radius for a non-colliding character position and, on Nauvis or Gleba only, the immediate conventional-hostile clearing radius. Native tiles, resources, cliffs, and decoratives are never rewritten. Vulcanus demolishers use a separate fixed six-chunk warning radius.

Default: `48`.

Range: `16` to `256`.

## Minimum team spawn separation

`sceatorio-planet-spawn-separation` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Minimum distance between different teams' recorded or pending spawns on the same planet surface. Changing this does not relocate stable existing spawns.

Default: `1024`.

Range: `128` to `16384`.

## Robot limit policy

`sceatorio-robot-policy-mode` · `runtime-global` · `string`

Enforce (the default) reports teams that reach a cap and pauses registered crafting machines whose current recipe produces the capped robot class. Warn reports without pausing. Disabled performs no recurring robot checks. Existing, flying, manually supplied, imported, and stored robots are never moved, deleted, or hidden.

Default: `enforce`.

Allowed values: `disabled` (Disabled), `warn` (Warn only), `enforce` (Warn and pause robot production).

## Logistic robots per team

`sceatorio-logistic-robot-cap` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Maximum total logistic robots across all fixed networks and surfaces owned by one team, so splitting networks cannot evade the budget. The default is intentionally conservative for multiplayer UPS. Set to 0 for unlimited.

Default: `500`.

Range: `0` to `1000000`.

## Construction robots per team

`sceatorio-construction-robot-cap` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Maximum total construction robots across all fixed networks and surfaces owned by one team. The higher default leaves room for large builds and repairs. Set to 0 for unlimited.

Default: `5000`.

Range: `0` to `1000000`.

## Enable AI assistance gateway

`sceatorio-ai-enabled` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

Server-wide opt-in for the localhost MCP gateway. Off by default. Factorio must also be started with --enable-lua-udp before a sidecar can connect.

Default: `false`.

## Allowed AI capabilities

`sceatorio-ai-allowed-capabilities` · `runtime-global` · `string`

Comma-separated server allowlist intersected with the researched technology and the pairing. Unknown names are ignored.

Default: `session:read,production:read,electricity:read,research:read,prototypes:read,factory:read,logistics:read,trains:read,alerts:read,map:read,circuits:read,events:read,blueprints:validate,blueprints:write,control_ports:write,annotations:write`.

## AI requests per minute

`sceatorio-ai-requests-per-minute` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Maximum requests accepted for one player across all of their clients during each minute of game time.

Default: `120`.

Range: `1` to `3600`.

## Expensive AI requests per minute

`sceatorio-ai-expensive-requests-per-minute` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Separate per-player budget for event waits, map, entity, train, logistics, transport, blueprint, and bounded control calls.

Default: `20`.

Range: `1` to `600`.

## Save-wide AI requests per minute

`sceatorio-ai-global-requests-per-minute` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Maximum requests accepted across every player and client in this save during each minute of game time. This is checked atomically with the per-player budgets.

Default: `600`.

Range: `1` to `36000`.

## Save-wide expensive AI requests per minute

`sceatorio-ai-global-expensive-requests-per-minute` · `runtime-global` · `int`

Maximum event waits, map, entity, train, logistics, transport, blueprint, and bounded control requests accepted across the save during each minute of game time. This is checked atomically with every other request budget.

Default: `120`.

Range: `1` to `36000`.

## Enable administrator development tools

`sceatorio-dev-tools-enabled` · `runtime-global` · `bool`

Shows temporary administrator-only diagnostics and test controls, including safe-arrival exercises and force-local research completion. Disabled by default for production servers.

Default: `false`.
